note: Four buyer roles, replacing the nine named personas. Four lines each — anything longer belongs in the personas deck.

roles.name: Operations
roles.owns: Portfolio performance. Occupancy, retention, NOI, and whether properties run to the same standard.
roles.measuredOn: NOI, renewal rate, time to lease, consistency across the portfolio.
roles.pushesBackOn: Anything that adds work to onsite teams who are already full. Wants to know who does the work, not what the software shows.
roles.hearThis: "Performance varies property to property and I can't tell if it's the market or the team."
roles.sayThat: Ask how they currently tell skill problems from process problems. That distinction is the whole sale, and nothing in a PMS makes it.

roles.name: L&D
roles.owns: Onboarding, role-based training, certification, and proving competency.
roles.measuredOn: Completion, time to productive, certification currency, audit readiness.
roles.pushesBackOn: Another login for onsite teams. Content that isn't multifamily. Anything that makes them the bottleneck.
roles.hearThis: "We need everyone trained and compliant, and I'm tracking it in a spreadsheet."
roles.sayThat: Completion proves attendance. Ask what they'd show an auditor to prove competency — and how long assembling it would take.

roles.name: Owner / Operator
roles.owns: The asset. Return, risk exposure, and the value of the management platform itself.
roles.measuredOn: NOI, valuation, litigation and compliance exposure, cost per unit.
roles.pushesBackOn: Anything priced as a growth bet. Wants payback period, not innovation.
roles.hearThis: "I can't buy my way to growth right now, so it has to come out of operations."
roles.sayThat: Agree, and make it concrete. With no cap-rate compression available, operational NOI is the only lever left — lead with payback, not capability.

roles.name: Marketing
roles.owns: Demand, brand consistency, reputation, and how properties present to prospects.
roles.measuredOn: Lead volume and quality, cost per lease, review ratings, brand consistency.
roles.pushesBackOn: Tools that don't connect to the leads or the listings they already run.
roles.hearThis: "Our reviews are inconsistent and I don't know which property is dragging the portfolio."
roles.sayThat: Reviews are the symptom. Ask what happens on site the week after a bad review lands, and who owns the fix.
